rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب
rows.claim: Ubayy is reported to say that the calamities and smoke have passed, while al-batsha and al-lizām are also named in connection with the verse's punishment.
rows.anchor: عن أبي بن كعب، في هذه الآية

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha relates that Abu Hudhayfa adopted Salim as the Prophet had adopted Zayd; she recalls that adopted sons had been called and inherited as sons until the verse restored known fathers and treated unknown parentage as brotherhood and clientage in faith.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة، أن أبا حذيفة، تبنى سالما - وهو مولى لامرأة من الأنصار - كما تبنى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم زيدا

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: In the report, the Prophet tells Sahla to nurse Salim five times, making him her son through foster kinship.
rows.anchor: قالت: يا رسول الله كنا نرى سالما ولدا يأوي معي، ومع أبي حذيفة ويراني فضلا وقد أنزل الله عز وجل فيهم ما قد علمت

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن بسر
rows.claim: ʿAbd Allah ibn Busr reports that, when asked for a comprehensive practice, the Prophet advised keeping the tongue continually moist with remembrance of God, echoing the verse's concern with God's remembrance.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الله بن بسر، قال: أتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أعرابيان

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن بسر
rows.claim: ʿAbd Allah ibn Busr reports that, when asked for an act to hold fast to amid many Islamic duties, the Prophet advised constant remembrance of God, echoing the verse's concern with God's remembrance.
rows.anchor: سمعت عبد الله بن بسر يقول

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Muʿadh reports the Prophet saying that no deed better saves a person from God's punishment than remembrance of God, directly reinforcing the verse's contrast with hearts hardened against remembrance.
rows.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ما عمل آدمي عملا قط أنجى له من عذاب الله من ذكر الله "

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Muʿadh reports that the Prophet calls remembrance of God the best, purest, and highest deed, superior to wealth and fighting, supporting the verse's emphasis on remembrance.
rows.anchor: وقال معاذ: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
